strings: r_c0 has noticed that m_c reeks of infection, but m_c hasn't noticed anything that could have caused it.
m_c complains that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} worse than usual; it seems like a scratch or other wound has become infected without notice.
There's an infection building in one of m_c's untended scratches.
